```{r}
#| label: setup
#| include: false
library(admetshiny)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(plotly)
library(DT)

set.seed(42)
knitr::opts_chunk$set(message = FALSE, warning = FALSE)

# ggplot -> plotly; si ggplotly no soporta alguna capa, muestra el ggplot estático
ip <- function(p) tryCatch(ggplotly(p), error = function(e) p)

# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# 1. DATOS
#    - Real: data/admet.rds, generado con data-raw/build-data.R
#    - Si no existe, se simula un dataset en el esquema estándar para
#      poder probar el dashboard.
# ------------------------------------------------------------------
if (file.exists("data/admet.rds")) {
  df <- readRDS("data/admet.rds")
} else {
  n <- 150
  MW <- round(pmax(rnorm(n, 380, 120), 120), 2)
  df <- data.frame(
    Name = sprintf("CPD-%03d", seq_len(n)),
    MW   = MW,
    LogP = round(rnorm(n, 3, 1.8), 2),
    TPSA = round(rgamma(n, shape = 6, scale = 15), 2),
    MR   = round(MW * 0.27 + rnorm(n, 0, 6), 2),
    "#H-bond acceptors"     = rpois(n, 5) + 1,
    "#H-bond donors"        = rpois(n, 2),
    "#Rotatable bonds"      = rpois(n, 5),
    "#Heavy atoms"          = round(MW / 13),
    "#Aromatic heavy atoms" = rpois(n, 6),
    check.names = FALSE
  )
}

# Columnas de violaciones y propiedades BOILED-Egg / P-gp (si faltan)
if (!any(grepl("#violations", names(df)))) df <- computeViolationColumns(df)
if (!"GI absorption" %in% names(df))       df <- computeADMETProperties(df)

df$Grupo <- ifelse(df[["Lipinski #violations"]] == 0,
                   "Lipinski OK", "Lipinski violado")

# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# 2. FILTROS DE DRUG-LIKENESS
# ------------------------------------------------------------------
filtros <- c("Lipinski", "Veber", "Ghose", "Egan", "Muegge")
resumen_filtros <- data.frame(
  Filtro = filtros,
  Pasan  = sapply(filtros, \(f) nrow(applyFilters(df, filters = f)))
) |>
  mutate(Porcentaje = round(100 * Pasan / nrow(df), 1))

pasan_todos <- applyFilters(df, filters = filtros)

pct <- function(x, yes) round(100 * mean(tolower(x) %in% tolower(yes), na.rm = TRUE))

props <- c("MW", "LogP", "TPSA", "MR", "#H-bond acceptors",
           "#H-bond donors", "#Rotatable bonds", "#Heavy atoms")
props <- intersect(props, names(df))
```

# Resumen

## Row {height="20%"}

```{r}
#| content: valuebox
#| title: "Compuestos"
list(icon = "capsule", color = "primary", value = nrow(df))
```

```{r}
#| content: valuebox
#| title: "Cumplen Lipinski"
list(icon = "check-circle", color = "success",
     value = paste0(resumen_filtros$Porcentaje[resumen_filtros$Filtro == "Lipinski"], "%"))
```

```{r}
#| content: valuebox
#| title: "Pasan los 5 filtros"
list(icon = "funnel", color = "info",
     value = paste0(round(100 * nrow(pasan_todos) / nrow(df)), "%"))
```

```{r}
#| content: valuebox
#| title: "Alta absorción GI"
list(icon = "egg-fried", color = "warning",
     value = paste0(pct(df[["GI absorption"]], "High"), "%"))
```

```{r}
#| content: valuebox
#| title: "Permean BBB"
list(icon = "lightning-charge", color = "danger",
     value = paste0(pct(df[["BBB permeant"]], "Yes"), "%"))
```

## Row {height="80%"}

```{r}
#| title: "Modelo BOILED-Egg"
ip(plotBoiledEgg(df))
```

```{r}
#| title: "Compuestos que pasan cada filtro (%)"
p <- ggplot(resumen_filtros,
            aes(x = reorder(Filtro, -Porcentaje), y = Porcentaje, fill = Filtro,
                text = paste0(Filtro, ": ", Pasan, " compuestos"))) +
  geom_col(show.legend = FALSE) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "% de compuestos") +
  theme_minimal()
ggplotly(p, tooltip = "text")
```

# Espacio químico

## Row {.tabset}

```{r}
#| title: "PCA"
plotPCA(df, variables = props, color_by = "Grupo")
```

```{r}
#| title: "t-SNE"
plotTSNE(df, variables = props, color_by = "Grupo",
         perplexity = min(30, floor((nrow(df) - 1) / 3) - 1))
```

```{r}
#| title: "UMAP"
plotUMAP(df, variables = props, color_by = "Grupo")
```

# Distribuciones

## Row

```{r}
#| title: "Peso molecular"
ip(plotMW(df))
```

```{r}
#| title: "TPSA"
ip(plotTPSA(df))
```

```{r}
#| title: "LogP"
ip(plotLogP(df))
```

## Row

```{r}
#| title: "MW por cumplimiento de Lipinski"
ip(plotViolin(df, variable = "MW", group_by = "Grupo"))
```

```{r}
#| title: "LogP por absorción GI"
ip(plotHistogramCustom(df, variable = "LogP", group_by = "GI absorption"))
```

```{r}
#| title: "Coordenadas paralelas"
plotParallel(df, variables = c("MW", "LogP", "TPSA"), color_by = "Grupo")
```

# Correlación y similitud

## Row

```{r}
#| title: "Correlación entre propiedades"
ip(plotCorrHeatmap(df, props = props))
```

```{r}
#| title: "Clustering jerárquico (primeros 60 compuestos)"
plotClusterHeatmap(head(df, 60), variables = props, id_col = "Name")
```

## Row

```{r}
#| title: "Perfil fisicoquímico (radar, 5 compuestos)"
ids <- head(df$Name, 5)
plotRadar(df, id_col = "Name", ids = ids)
```

```{r}
#| title: "Similitud estructural Tanimoto / AGNES"
# Requiere columna SMILES real y Java (rcdk) al renderizar
ok <- "SMILES" %in% names(df) && any(!is.na(df$SMILES))
if (ok) {
  tryCatch(
    plotTanimoto(df, smiles_col = "SMILES", label_col = "Name", max_n = 40),
    error = function(e) { plot.new(); text(.5, .5, "Tanimoto no disponible\n(¿Java/rcdk?)") }
  )
} else {
  plot.new(); text(.5, .5, "Sin SMILES en los datos")
}
```

# Datos

## Row {height="15%"}

```{r}
#| title: "Resumen de filtros"
datatable(resumen_filtros, rownames = FALSE,
          options = list(dom = "t", paging = FALSE))
```

## Row {height="85%"}

```{r}
#| title: "Tabla completa (exportable)"
datatable(
  df, rownames = FALSE, filter = "top",
  extensions = c("Buttons", "Scroller"),
  options = list(dom = "Bfrtip", buttons = c("csv", "excel"),
                 scrollX = TRUE, scrollY = 400, scroller = TRUE)
)
```

# Acerca de

::: card
**ADMETShiny Dashboard** muestra, de forma estática, el análisis ADMET y de drug-likeness generado con el paquete [`admetshiny`](https://github.com/xavierclementegarcia/admetshiny) (filtros Lipinski, Veber, Ghose, Egan y Muegge; BOILED-Egg; clasificador P-gp; PCA, t-SNE, UMAP; clustering Tanimoto/AGNES).
:::
